# An IRIX 6.5.30 minimal install on an Origin 200, as it looks on the serial
# console to `origami install-apply`: the guest sits at the inst menu, the
# product loads the install script and picks the distribution, inst installs
# and runs the post-install commands, "quit" restarts the machine, and the
# first boot ends at the login prompt. Cut from the console of a recorded
# install, with the README, most progress lines and the PROM banner left out.
# Played by tests/bin/fake.rs, which documents the directives.
outln Inst 4.1 Main Menu
outln
outln  1. from [source ...]            Specify location of software to be installed
outln  2. open [source ...]            Specify additional software locations
outln  3. close [source ...]           Close a software distribution location
outln  4. list [keywords] [names]      Display information about software subsystems
outln  5. go                           Perform software installation and removal now
outln  6. install [keywords] [names]   Select subsystems to be installed
outln  7. remove [keywords] [names]    Select subsystems to be removed
outln  8. keep [keywords] [names]      Do not install or remove these subsystems
outln  9. step [keywords] [names]      Interactive mode for install/remove/keep
outln 10. conflicts [choice ...]       List or resolve installation conflicts
outln 11. help [topic]                 Get help in general or on a specific word
outln 12. view ...                     Go to the View Commands Menu
outln 13. admin ...                    Go to the Administrative Commands Menu
outln 14. quit                         Terminate software installation
in \n
out \r\nInst>\x20
in admin source 10.98.0.2:/irix.cmds\n
outln
outln Reading product descriptions ..   0%  100% Done.
outln
outln This distribution contains overlay products.  You may need to specify
outln additional distributions that contain the base software for these overlays.
outln If you do not load all the related distributions now, "Conflict" messages
outln later in the installation will prompt you to load any other necessary CDs.
outln (See the "overlay" help topic for more information.)
outln
outln You can enter the name of a different distribution and press "Enter."
outln
outln Or, enter "done" if you are ready to proceed with the installation now.
outln
outln  1 10.98.0.2:/6.5.30/dist
outln  2 10.98.0.2:/foundations/dist
outln  3 done (distribution information read, return to inst prompt)
outln
out Install software from: [10.98.0.2:/6.5.30/dist]\x20
in 3\n
outln
outln No matches for "java_dev.sw.base" were found
outln Reading fileset information ..   0%   4%
outln Pre-installation check ..   8%   16%
outln Checking space requirements ..  16%  24%
outln Installing/removing files ..  24%
outln Installing new versions of selected eoe.sw subsystems
outln Installing new versions of selected eoe.sw64 subsystems
outln Installing new versions of selected eoe.man subsystems
outln Installing/removing files ..  94%
outln Running exit-commands ..  96%
outln Running exit-commands ..  98%  99%
outln Checking dependencies ..  99% 100% Done.
outln Calculating sizes ..   0% 100% Done.
outln
outln chrooting to /root
outln
outln Calculating sizes ..   0% 100% Done.
outln
outln chrooting to /root
outln
outln
outln instigator: post-install commands finished
outln
out \r\nInst>\x20
in quit\n
outln
outln Requickstarting ELF files (see rqsall(1)) ..   0%   100% Done.
outln Automatically reconfiguring the operating system.
out Ready to restart the system.  Restart? { (y)es, (n)o, (sh)ell, (h)elp }:\x20
in y\n
outln
outln Preparing to restart system ...
outln
outln The system is being restarted.
outln
outln                            Starting up the system...
outln
outln Setting rbaud to 19200
outln NOTICE: Starting failsoftd
outln The system is coming up.
outln network: WARNING: IRIS's Internet address is the default.
outln Using standalone network mode.
outln Doing firstrun configuration...
outln System change detected.
outln
out base console login:\x20
